latHint: Think the little thing that drives you mad - not a rose spike.
pivHint: A THORN pricks your finger on a rose - but a THORN in your side is your pet what?
winText: Pricked. THORN was the pivot - a rose spike to a pet PEEVE.
lossText: PEEVE - an annoyance. THORN was the pivot: a rose THORN to a THORN in the side.
